bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no larger than 6" x 9" and clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: fanny packs no larger than 6" x 9"
clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at Dos Equis Pavilion requires a purchased pass per vehicle, with general parking starting at $20 online or $25 on-site. Upgraded options like Easy Out, Ultra VIP, VIP, and Reserved Parking are available for closer access and faster entry.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Dos Equis Pavilion's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Dos Equis Pavilion offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizza. Koko's Bavarian provides a taste of German culture with sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer classic snacks like popcorn and nachos with a selection of beverages.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Dos Equis Pavilion, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Dos Equis Pavilion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Dos Equis Pavilion. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Dos Equis Pavilion. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
